Show your work.

“Provable” is its own pillar of the engine: every fact Baltor serves carries a signed receipt and a source handle, so you can trace any answer back to the exact clause it came from. Pick a served fact to open its receipt — the verification and optimization sub-receipts, and the full lineage from origin to served pack.

Trace a served fact

Receipts are signed & exportable — the audit trail behind the answer
Provenance beside the rest. A receipt is only meaningful because the fact it signs was already reconciled, hardened, enhanced and optimized — provenance records that the other engine stages happened and that the served answer is the one they produced. Receipts are signed and exportable into an AIBOM / audit dossier. Not legal, medical, or financial advice — the source in force is the authority; Baltor preserves its citation and receipt.
